steps.title: Maya: neighbour welcome guide · part 1
steps.detail: Maya is making a welcome walk for a neighbour who uses a wheelchair. The park has a step-free path, while the shortcut has stairs. Which route belongs in the guide?

choices.label: Use the step-free path and state the longer walk

steps.title: Maya: neighbour welcome guide · part 2
steps.detail: Maya found that her old welcome guide lists a cafe as open at night, but its current timetable ends at 18:00. What should the revision say?

choices.label: Publish the current hours and note the earlier error

steps.title: Maya: neighbour welcome guide · part 3
steps.detail: A residents association asks Maya to introduce you for a paid welcome guide. They want a guarantee that every visitor will find a home. What can you offer?

choices.label: A checked guide with contacts and clear limits

referral.detail: A referred client commissions a documented neighbour welcome guide. Complete the agreed work; no revenue is earned merely for knowing Maya.
